result.brief: 提出免训练的频域特征预测加速方法，用DCT与逐系数Kalman滤波沿噪声调度时间轴外推DiT输出，自适应决定何时重新计算，在FLUX、Qwen-Image、Wan2.1与HunyuanVideo上实现最高6倍加速且保真度损失小。
result.reason: Training-free feature forecasting in frequency domain to accelerate DiT image/video diffusion inference; directly serves video generation efficiency and denoising-step representation reuse.
